comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To summarize the above info:

You can plunder the Pirates Notes treasure map from Islamic Dynasty Fleet which appears as Ambush (no Caution, Highlookout or Pet skills which cancel ambushes active) in the Red Sea. The map has a chance to drop this outfit, but it isn't 100% so you may need/want extra maps.

If anybody can provide more specific info, please feel free to. Cheers.
